import io
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def parsed_cell(text):
    return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(text), header=None, engine="c").iloc[0, 0]


val_u = int(np.iinfo(np.uint64).max) + 1   # 18446744073709551616
val_i = int(np.iinfo(np.int64).min) - 1    # -9223372036854775809

cell_u = parsed_cell(str(val_u))
cell_i = parsed_cell(str(val_i))

probe("outside_uint64_is_python_int", int(isinstance(cell_u, int) and not isinstance(cell_u, str)))
probe("outside_int64_is_python_int", int(isinstance(cell_i, int) and not isinstance(cell_i, str)))
probe("outside_uint64_is_str", int(isinstance(cell_u, str)))
probe("outside_int64_is_str", int(isinstance(cell_i, str)))
probe("outside_uint64_equals_value", int(cell_u == val_u))
probe("outside_int64_equals_value", int(cell_i == val_i))

res = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(str(val_u) + "\nabc"), header=None, engine="c")
probe("follow_str_second_is_abc", int(res.iloc[1, 0] == "abc"))
